reviewType: Independent full-source static review of a newly authored, unexecuted private fixture

registration.method: Literal declaration and name comparison only; no parser or collection

sensitivityAnchors.case: Q2 missing evidence stays null before any status or current-value assertions
Q6a an empty assertion list stays null before later nonvacuity checks

checks.importsAndTypes: Actual .mjs named exports, ESM package, existing allowJs:true and YAML installation support the proposed source route. No import, typecheck or compilation result is claimed.
checks.planAndRegistration: Literal 15-row/90-target-cell table matches the directly read Plan; exact historical G1-G26 and seven/fifteen/four severity declarations remain assertions, not new measurements.
checks.genuineGit: Owned native init/local config/add/commit/rev-parse/checkout/cat-file/merge-base commands and genuine branch topology; no fake Git, remote, reset, force, hook bypass or shared repository writes.
checks.childArgvAndDeadlines: process.execPath invokes exact copied script; Git uses scoped PATH. File-backed streams avoid pipe maxBuffer termination. No command timeout, retry, signal or test timeout override; existing 30-second config and product five-second Git limit retained.
checks.effectScope: Only new owned fixture paths are written. Borrowed node_modules link is unstaged and no dependency command runs. No cleanup of shared data or fixture roots.
checks.evidenceContract: Optional external artifact root is absolute, non-symlink and source-disjoint. wx records retain selected exact input bytes, supplied outputs, argv, env keys, commits/parents, child status and raw streams before assertions.
checks.environment: Eight explicitly supplied child keys; only PATH value is inherited. No environment values recorded. This is distinct from outer inherited environment and future causal seven-key policy.

runtimePrerequisites: Later setup binds a fresh owned private artifact root with appropriate ownership/mode and exact environment value; omission is insufficient for qualification.
Outer wrapper/controller and eventual actual post-exit audit remain required; this fixture supplies no process-group or complete-teardown proof.
limits: Static authored definitions are not collected or passed cases.
TypeScript correctness and actual module loading are unmeasured.
The artifact-root helper does not independently enforce ownership/mode/freshness/emptiness.
Synchronous child completion is unbounded by the helper; original Vitest deadline is not an OS process termination guarantee.
Selected snapshots and tagged non-JSON values do not establish exhaustive filesystem preservation or generic independent replay.
Local synthetic history is not merge approval, signature trust, actual program measurement or a truthful gap closure.
Later assertions may be masked by the first failing assertion.
No online query, external post, target decision, full suite, Node24, release, Done or inherited-debt waiver is asserted.
